_doc: The components and OnTap actions the engine reads. Source of truth for the declaration reader, the stubs (apkpygame/_components.py, generated) and src/tools/check_schema.py (which checks the Java readers). 'args' are the positional parameters, in order; '*name' takes the rest. 'json' renames a field in the bundle; 'python_only' fields are resolved by the build.

components.name: Sprite
components.doc: An image (or a region/frame of an atlas). One texel = one world unit; the pivot is the point at the entity's position.

frame.doc: with an atlas: the frame name (file name without extension) or index

components.name: Canvas
components.doc: Pixels the game paints while it runs. Scripts set and read any pixel and draw lines, rectangles, circles, fills and stamps of images (self.canvas.set(x, y, "#ff0000")); with brush= the player paints with a finger. One pixel is one world unit; the pivot is the point at the entity's position.

width.doc: in pixels; with image= and no width, the image's

height.doc: in pixels; with image= and no height, the image's

image.doc: a PNG it starts from: assets.image(...), or a frame of a sheet or an atlas

frame.doc: with a sheet or an atlas: the frame it starts from

filter.doc: nearest keeps each pixel a sharp square when drawn bigger

brush.doc: the colour the player paints with a finger (none: the player does not paint)

brush_size.doc: how wide the brush is, in pixels

components.name: Shape
components.doc: A rectangle or a circle, filled or outlined.

components.name: Text
components.doc: Text; the entity's position is the baseline of the first line at the alignment point. Colours inside: "Won [c=#ffd84a]50[/c] coins".

text.doc: a text, or t("key") from the app's translations()

font.doc: assets.font(...); by default the game's font, or the system's

max_width.doc: lines are broken to fit this width; 0: only at \n

line_spacing.doc: times the font's distance between lines

max_lines.doc: lines per page (text.page, text.pages); 0: one page

components.name: Panel
components.doc: A box of any size: an image cut in nine (border: the size of its corners), or a plain colour with a line. modal: a press anywhere stops here, so nothing below an open menu can be tapped.

components.name: Button
components.doc: A button with a label. A click is a finger going down and coming up on it (sliding off cancels). It plays its sound, runs its actions, and scripts see self.button.clicked.

image.doc: cut in nine, like a Panel

components.name: Bar
components.doc: A bar filling from the left that glides to a new value (life bars), changing colour at two thresholds. Scripts: self.bar.value, .max, .shown, .moving.

speed.doc: fractions of max per second; 0: at once

components.name: ScrollList
components.doc: A long list, or a grid with columns > 1. Only the rows that fit exist, used again as it scrolls; a Script on the same entity fills them in on_row(self, row, index). Drag to scroll. A row is an entity at the centre of its cell. On a ui entity.

components.name: Tabs
components.doc: A row of tabs, one always selected. Scripts: self.tabs.selected, self.tabs.changed. Its origin is its top-left corner.

components.name: Toggle
components.doc: A box that is on or off, with a label. Scripts: self.toggle.value, self.toggle.changed.

components.name: Slider
components.doc: A value set with a finger along a track. Scripts: self.slider.value, self.slider.changed.

step.doc: values go in these steps; 0: any

image.doc: the thumb, instead of a colour

components.name: Keyboard
components.doc: A keyboard drawn in the game. Letters are capital until the first one is typed. Scripts: self.keyboard.text, .changed, .done. Its origin is its top-left corner.

rows.doc: the letters of each row; by default QWERTY

components.name: Spin
components.doc: Turns the entity at a constant speed (degrees per second).

components.name: Mover
components.doc: Moves at a constant velocity (units per second); with bounce, turns back at the edges.

components.name: OnTap
components.doc: Runs actions, in order, when the entity is tapped (area: its Sprite/Shape, or radius/size).

components.name: Collider
components.doc: The shape for the physics (axis-aligned box or circle). solid: bodies cannot pass; trigger: only reports contacts.

components.name: Body
components.doc: Arcade physics: velocity, gravity (units/s2, down), blocked by solid tiles and solid colliders.

components.name: OnCollide
components.doc: Runs actions when this entity starts touching another with the tag, from a side (top = the other came from above).

components.name: PlatformerController
components.doc: Run and jump (needs Body with gravity and a Collider). Keys: arrows/A/D, space/up/W, or TouchButton left/right/jump.

components.name: TopDownController
components.doc: Moves towards the finger while it is down, else with the arrow keys; axis x / y / both.

components.name: Follow
components.doc: Moves towards the entity called target, or the nearest with tag.

components.name: Patrol
components.doc: Walks left and right; turns at walls, ledges (edges) or after distance (needs Body).

components.name: Spawner
components.doc: Makes copies of an entity every few seconds, at the spawner (+ offset) or in an area (x, y, w, h).

components.name: Lifetime
components.doc: Destroys the entity after seconds (running the actions first).

components.name: Timer
components.doc: Runs actions every few seconds (repeat=False: once).

components.name: Tween
components.doc: Animates x, y, rotation, scale or alpha to a value.

components.name: Animator
components.doc: Frame animations of the entity's Sprite: {"run": {"frames": [0, 1, 2], "fps": 10}}. auto: plays the PlatformerController state (idle, run, jump, fall).

components.name: Emitter
components.doc: Particles: burst at start, then rate per second for duration (0: forever). angle in degrees (90 = down).

components.name: Tilemap
components.doc: A map made in Tiled (assets.tilemap). solid: the tile layers that block bodies. objects: an entity for each Tiled object name/class.

solid.doc: layer names (default: layers with the Tiled property solid=true, or named "solid")

components.name: Billboard
components.doc: 2.5D: a sprite standing on the ground, turned to the camera. image: a sheet (assets.sheet) with one row per direction (1, 4: down, left, up, right; 8: with the diagonals in between) and one column per walking frame.

facing.doc: degrees on the ground: 0 down, 90 right, 180 up, 270 left

stand.doc: follow the heights of the scene's Tilemap

components.name: Block
components.doc: 2.5D: a box on the ground (houses, walls, crates): size (width, depth) around the entity, height up. top/side: an image stretched on the face, or a colour.

components.name: Plane
components.doc: 2.5D: one picture as a quad, standing (signs, fences) or flat on the ground (rugs, shadows); cross: two standing quads at right angles (a cheap tree).

components.name: GridController
components.doc: Walks one tile at a time (arrows/WASD, TouchButton keys, or tapping a cell). A short press in a new direction only turns. Blocked by solid tiles and by entities with the tags in block: such an entity fills its cell, and one with a Block (a house) every cell the Block is on.

tile.doc: the size of a cell, world units

tap.doc: walk to a tapped cell (set False with on-screen buttons)

block.doc: tags of the entities it cannot walk through

components.name: TouchButton
components.doc: An on-screen button (ui=True entity with a Shape/Sprite) that holds a key: left, right, jump, space...

actions.name: destroy
actions.doc: Removes an entity: this one, or target="other" (the one touched).

actions.name: var_add
actions.doc: Adds to a game variable (score, lives...): texts show it as {name}.

actions.name: spawn
actions.doc: Makes a copy of an entity at self / other (+ offset), or at the world point offset (at="world").

actions.name: goto_scene
actions.doc: Changes scene (variables carry over). at: entities tagged "arrives" appear at the entity or Tiled object of that name. fade: seconds to black and back.

actions.name: impulse
actions.doc: Sets a Body's velocity (keep_x: only vertical), e.g. bounce off a stomped enemy.

actions.name: respawn
actions.doc: Puts an entity back where it entered the scene, stopped.

actions.name: deflect
actions.doc: Sends a Body away from what it touched, turned by where it touched it: straight from the middle, up to angle degrees at the ends. Its speed stays. A ball on a paddle: OnCollide("paddle", deflect()) on the ball, and the player aims.

angle.doc: degrees from straight, at the very end of what it touched

actions.name: exit_game
actions.doc: Ends the game; the ApkPy screen gets {"action": "exit", "result": result}.

actions.name: open_app
actions.doc: Opens an ApkPy screen; the game is suspended (game_resume continues it).

actions.name: store_add
actions.doc: Adds to a number in the store shared with the app (game_get); var="score" adds that variable's value.

actions.name: store_set
actions.doc: Sets a text in the store shared with the app.

actions.name: only_if
actions.doc: Runs the actions after it only when the condition holds now, as in when(...): "keys >= 1" (a game variable) or "count(coin) == 0" (the entities with a tag). A door that needs a key, a shop that needs coins.

condition.doc: name op number, or count(tag) op number
